carriedFromR45.shell: Compared in Chromium against the same DOM on the DS documentation base (browser/before-u15.json, browser/final.json). Fixed: the 28px brand mark (family 38px), the 16/32/32px main padding (published 20px), the pages centred at 1040/1100px (now the content stack: top bar location, page title and content start at the same 300px edge at four widths), the brand button (now the home link), the mobile toggle without Button classes, the missing collapse control. Kept as application placement: the one-viewport shell with the status row and inner scroll, the dashboard stat grid, the top bar's two-track grid.
carriedFromR45.identity: Visible labels hold names, Unnamed project or Unavailable project with the shortest id tails when alike; complete identities live in keyboard Details with a copy action; titles and accessible names carry no complete id. Measured in Chromium: Enter/Space open, Escape closes with focus on the summary, the copied value equals the identity.
carriedFromR45.readiness: Project readiness replaced the JSON dump with Badges, labels and engine names of missing requirements.
carriedFromR45.proofs: design-proof leg 6 scans anchors and summaries against their published families; leg 11 checks every side-navigation destination by tag and slots; the dashboard measure invariant now names the content stack.
dsGaps: The ProductShell utility row has no single-line arrangement for Atelier's seven top bar controls; it wraps at 1024 and 1280.
Clipboard has no static bridge; Atelier composes the documented Button and status-region construction with the family's labels.
notVerified: locales other than en in the browser

currentR46.shell: The top bar keeps R45's two-track construction. R46 built the published utility row (option 1) and measured it in Chromium at 1024, 1280, 1440 and 1680 px, five languages, both themes, eight pages and four chains: it wraps to two lines at 1024 in every combination, at 1280 for a library with more than one project, and at 1440 for that library in fr and ja; 1680 keeps one line. The construction was reverted with git revert and the choice is the Owner's (c3). Every language now takes the published --tcrn-type-family-ui: the four per-language overrides are gone, and the computed family of the body, a side navigation item and the top bar equals the production documentation's in all five languages.
currentR46.tables: The gate table has three columns and the record tables fit 1024 px without sideways scroll, on the published TableShell variables only; see the TableShell row.
dsGaps: The ProductShell utility row has no single-line arrangement for Atelier's top bar controls at 1024 px, nor at 1280 px with the configuration target shown (carried from R45; measured again in R46).
Clipboard has no static bridge; Atelier composes the documented Button and status-region construction (carried from R45).

TableShell has no narrow-desktop arrangement for wide editable tables (for example a sticky actions column, or the stacked cards above 520 px): at 1024 px with the side navigation expanded the model tier table keeps every column visible only by letting most fields scroll their value.
